product.body_html:
COSRX One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pad 100ea

Description

Revitalize and firm your complexion with these high-performance lifting and glowing pads. Formulated with a potent blend of Collagen and an advanced Peptide Complex (including Copper Tripeptide-1 and Acetyl Hexapeptide-8), these pads work to visibly improve skin elasticity, plump fine lines, and deliver a youthful bounce. Enriched with Niacinamide for brightening and a multi-molecular Hyaluronic Acid complex for deep, multi-layered hydration. Infused with Peach Flower Extract and Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin), which gives the essence its natural pink hue, it restores vitality and a healthy, radiant glow to tired and dull skin.

 

How to use

After cleansing, gently wipe the embossed side of the pad across your face, avoiding the eye area, to lightly exfoliate and refine skin texture. Flip the pad over and use the smooth side to prep and condition the skin. Lightly pat the remaining essence into the skin until fully absorbed. For an intensive lifting and glowing treatment, leave the pads on targeted areas (like cheeks or forehead) for 3-5 minutes like a sheet mask.

 

Ingredients

Water, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Tripropylene Glycol, Niacinamide, Pentylene Glycol, 2,3-Butanediol, Betaine, Lactobacillus Ferment, Propanediol, Diethoxyethyl Succinate, Hydroxyacetophenone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Adenosine, Arginine, Carbomer, Disodium EDTA, Xanthan Gum, Glyceryl Acrylate/Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Allantoin, Panthenol, Cyanocobalamin, Prunus Persica (Peach) Flower Extract, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Pantothenic Acid, Tocopherol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5, Copper Tripeptide-1, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Dimethylsilanol Hyaluronate, Potassium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Collagen, Sodium Hyaluronate Dimethylsilanol, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Collagen Extract.

 

Specs

  • Brand : COSRX

  • Capacity : 100 Pads (300ml)

  • Target Area : Face

  • Skin Type : All skin types, especially mature and dull skin

  • Country of origin : South Korea
